question: 2026 年 6 月每个大区的订单实付金额合计是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT big.name, SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY big.name
note: 金额口径 + 三级地域上卷

question: 订单数超过 4000 的渠道有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.channel HAVING COUNT(*) > 4000
note: 列契约：必须同时输出计数列

question: 评价数多于 10 条的商品，平均评分是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(avg_rating) FROM (SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)
